boundaries.responsibility: language-neutral typed contract for destination-bound attenuating export envelopes
boundaries.activation_condition: activate when an export crosses a mission-thread boundary and its destination, authority attenuation, expiry, content address, and schema version must be represented independently of the Python process
boundaries.why_existing_boundary_is_insufficient: the current Python ExportGrant is an in-process object and does not provide an evolvable language-neutral wire contract for cross-runtime verification
boundaries.interface_contract: a versioned Protobuf ExportEnvelope binds export ID, source thread, destination thread, key identity, content digest, authority scope, not-after time, single-use semantics, and schema version; Python remains the reference orchestrator and must round-trip shared fixtures without semantic loss
boundaries.parity_contract: shared deterministic fixtures must round-trip between the Python reference model and generated Protobuf representation with identical destination, attenuation, expiry, single-use, and content-digest fields

boundaries.responsibility: independently replayable content-addressed provenance and tamper-evident transfer verification
boundaries.activation_condition: activate when a destination-bound export is emitted and an isolated verifier must validate canonical bytes, content address, destination binding, attenuation, expiry, and transfer-chain integrity outside the mutable Python thread-state process
boundaries.why_existing_boundary_is_insufficient: the Python process owns mutable mission-thread orchestration; the provenance verifier should be a separately executable native boundary with explicit byte ownership and no ambient access to mission-thread mutable state
boundaries.interface_contract: Rust consumes the canonical Protobuf export envelope plus previous receipt hash and returns a deterministic verification receipt containing envelope digest, provenance-chain digest, decision, and bounded refusal reason; it cannot mutate thread state or mint export authority
boundaries.parity_contract: Python reference verification and Rust verification must agree on allow/refuse, canonical envelope digest, destination binding, expiry, attenuation, and tamper cases across shared fixtures; divergence fails the evolution gate

diversity_value: Protobuf owns the cross-language contract boundary and Rust owns an isolated native provenance-verification boundary, while Python keeps mission-thread orchestration. The added technologies have distinct responsibilities and do not duplicate Python merely to increase language count.
nonclaims: Tower placement is bound to the prospective Tower governance branch semantic blobs and becomes canonical only when those same authority surfaces are merged to Tower main
Rust is an experiment until its declared Tier B parity and adversarial proof passes; the current Python implementation remains authoritative
Protobuf placement does not itself prove generated-code integration or wire compatibility until the evolution implementation and tests pass
no Lockheed Martin affiliation, adoption, production deployment, proprietary access, or internal architecture knowledge is claimed
